reason: Rich's rule for chat dock reply width was relayed by the system agent and built this episode: replies have no character cap and take the width their content needs, up to the dock less the log padding. The rule is not written anywhere a future agent would find it, and the 72ch cap it replaced would return on the next edit. Also captures the measured-probe method used to prove it and the flex-wrap side effect.
Reply-width rule is a bullet in the metaform-web-ui Chat dock section.
